description: Illustrative demo data. Demo-video campaign: the SMS in docs/demo/video-sms.txt (bank account "hacked", pay a security deposit, keep it secret), reported by 4 synthetic networks (documentation addresses 203.0.113.101-104 through the real HMAC path). Each case names the UPI ID and the wallet together, so they are linked in the graph. The UPI ID is under the demo @okdemo handle; the wallet is the demo value from the video script and is on no list. Seeded by web/scripts/seed-india-cases.ts and removed by --remove.

campaigns.11: Demo video: bank account hacked / fake security deposit
